proposal.root_cause: Column projection errors (SELECT Name vs SELECT *) and NULL-handling in NOT IN/EXISTS
proposal.what: Update system_prompt.md to explicitly mandate `SELECT *` or all columns from the main table for 'details'/'which [entity]' questions, correcting previous over-generalization that led to column mismatches. Also strengthen the rule for exclusion queries ('do not have any') to prefer `NOT EXISTS` or `IS NULL` checks over `NOT IN` to handle NULLs correctly, addressing sp0894.
